floatingToolbar.promptPolish: Polish the prose to make it more vivid and elegant.
floatingToolbar.promptCondenseSystem: You are an editor who excels at concise writing. Compress the following text to 60-70% of its original length while preserving the core meaning. Output only the result.
floatingToolbar.promptRewriteSystem: You are a creative writer. Rewrite the following text in a completely different style while keeping the core meaning. Output only the result.
floatingToolbar.promptCheckSystem: You are a meticulous review editor. Check the following text for issues (logical contradictions, awkward wording, grammar errors, inconsistencies, etc.). List the issues briefly; if there are none, say "No issues found".

consistencyFindings.heldItemReason: "{{itemName}}" was already in possession before this chapter (held by: {{holder}}), yet the text describes it as being acquired/obtained/found again, potentially causing duplicate acquisition.
consistencyFindings.heldItemSuggestion: Change to using, confirming, retrieving, or mentioning the item's source to avoid writing it as a first-time acquisition again.
consistencyFindings.lifecycleReason: "{{characterName}}" was already marked as dead by Canon before this chapter began, yet the text has them acting normally as a living character.
consistencyFindings.lifecycleSuggestion: Change to corpse, memory, dream, or reported speech context; if the character has truly been revived, please first extract and confirm a new aliveStatus=alive fact.
